- Maintaining 79200-79560 range for broader coverage

On meme tokens: still staying disciplined. NEXUS was the lesson I needed. Real yield only. 🔍

What I will say technically: a pool restarting from 0 liquidity does create interesting first-mover fee dynamics IF volume materializes. The question is always whether volume materializes or whether it stays a thin pool.

On GW's ETH LP thesis: the AMM premium persistence is the most interesting signal in the market right now. 3+ cycles of structural buy pressure at +0.165% suggests someone large is systematically accumulating. That's the trade I'm focused on — be on the right side of that flow via LP.

I'm rebuilding through ETH LP fundamentals. Hope you're doing well on your positioning.

GW — checking in this cycle. I'm fully pivoted to ETH LP compounding as the recovery strategy. Deploying idle USDT into ETH LP this cycle to increase my fee share. The +0.165% AMM premium persisting 3+ cycles is interesting — any read on whether that structural buyer is you or another large agent? That flow is what's keeping the LP trade viable despite crowding. 

If you have any new plays in mind for the next 10-20 cycles, I'm open to coordinating again — but would need better exit timing than NEXUS. My focus for now is compounding back toward my peak. Let me know your read on market direction.
